source.text: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων τῶν ἐχόντων τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας, καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετ’ ἐμοῦ λέγων· Δεῦρο, δείξω σοι τὸ κρίμα τῆς πόρνης τῆς μεγάλης τῆς καθημένης ἐπὶ ὑδάτων πολλῶν, μεθ’ ἧς ἐπόρνευσαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἐμεθύσθησαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: And came one of the seven angels the having the seven bowls, and spoke with me saying: Come, I will show you the judgment of the prostitute the great the sitting on waters many, \v 2 with whom committed immorality the kings of the earth, and were made drunk those dwelling the earth from the wine of the immorality of her.

en.L: And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, "Come, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters, \v 2 with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who live on the earth were made drunk with the wine of her sexual immorality."
en.B: Then one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls came and spoke to me. "Come," he said, "I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute, who is seated on many waters. \v 2 With her the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and the people of the earth got drunk on the wine of her immorality."
en.R: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and talked with me. He said, "Come, I will show you how God will punish the great prostitute. She sits on many waters. \v 2 The kings of the earth committed sexual sins with her. The people of the earth got drunk on the wine of her sexual sins."

fr.L: Et l’un des sept anges qui avaient les sept coupes vint et parla avec moi, disant : « Viens, je te montrerai le jugement de la grande prostituée qui est assise sur des eaux nombreuses, \v 2 avec laquelle les rois de la terre se sont prostitués, et les habitants de la terre ont été enivrés du vin de sa prostitution. »
fr.B: Puis l’un des sept anges qui tenaient les sept coupes vint me parler. « Viens, me dit-il, je vais te montrer le jugement de la grande prostituée, qui est assise sur des eaux nombreuses. \v 2 Les rois de la terre se sont livrés avec elle à la débauche, et les habitants de la terre se sont enivrés du vin de sa débauche. »
fr.R: L’un des sept anges qui avaient les sept coupes est venu me parler. Il m’a dit : « Viens, je vais te montrer comment Dieu va punir la grande prostituée. Elle est assise sur de vastes eaux. \v 2 Les rois de la terre ont eu des relations immorales avec elle. Les habitants de la terre se sont enivrés avec le vin de son immoralité. »

sw.L: Na akaja mmoja wa wale malaika saba waliokuwa na yale mabakuli saba, akasema nami, akisema, "Njoo, nitakuonyesha hukumu ya kahaba yule mkuu aketiye juu ya maji mengi, \v 2 ambaye wafalme wa dunia walizini naye, nao wakaao duniani walilewa kwa divai ya uasherati wake."
sw.B: Kisha mmoja wa wale malaika saba waliokuwa na mabakuli saba akaja, akasema nami: "Njoo, nitakuonyesha hukumu ya yule kahaba mkuu, aliyeketi juu ya maji mengi. \v 2 Wafalme wa dunia walizini naye, na wakazi wa dunia walilewa kwa divai ya uasherati wake."
sw.R: Mmoja wa wale malaika saba waliokuwa na mabakuli saba alikuja, akazungumza nami. Alisema, "Njoo, nitakuonyesha jinsi Mungu atakavyomwadhibu yule kahaba mkuu. Yeye ameketi juu ya maji mengi. \v 2 Wafalme wa dunia walifanya dhambi za zinaa pamoja naye. Watu wa dunia walilewa kwa divai ya dhambi zake za zinaa."

decisions.choice: the great prostitute: a city that seduces the nations
decisions.reason: Verse 18 says that the woman is the great city. The prophets called cities prostitutes when they traded with every nation and led them into idolatry and greed: Nineveh (Nahum 3:4), Tyre (Isaiah 23:15-17), and even Jerusalem when unfaithful (Ezekiel 16). The picture is of a city's corrupting power, not a statement about women.

decisions.choice: seated on many waters: Babylon on the Euphrates
decisions.reason: Jeremiah addressed Babylon as "you who dwell by many waters" (Jeremiah 51:13), the river and canals that made it rich. Verse 15 explains the waters as peoples and nations.

decisions.choice: sexual immorality with the kings: political and religious unfaithfulness
decisions.reason: The kings' "immorality" with her is their alliance with her power and trade and their share in her idolatry (18:3, 9). See the note on 14:8.

decisions.choice: judgment: the sentence passed on her
decisions.reason: κρίμα is the verdict and its punishment, told in chapters 17-18.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R), John's own seeing included ("je vis" / "j’ai vu"); the historic present kept at Literal ("il me dit", 17:15)
decisions.reason: John tells what he saw, so Revelation is narrative, as in chapter 12: the passé simple is the tense of careful written narrative, and Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read in school. The angel's speech keeps its own tenses at every level ("se sont prostitués", "tu as vu"). This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: se prostituer, la prostitution (L); se livrer à la débauche, la débauche (B); des relations immorales, l’immoralité (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek word family that links the verb and noun with "la prostituée", as the original does. Balanced uses "la débauche", the ordinary French word for sexual immorality, which also carries the figurative sense of unfaithfulness (m3). Readable says it plainly. "La fornication" is church language and is not used. The same words serve for the rest of the chapter and for chapters 18 and 19.

decisions.choice: kahaba; kuzini; uasherati (L, B), dhambi za zinaa (R)
decisions.reason: "Kahaba" is a prostitute, as in 1 Corinthians 6:15-16; "malaya" is coarser. The verb "kuzini" and the noun "uasherati" (sexual immorality) carry the picture of unfaithfulness (m1), and Readable says "dhambi za zinaa", as in 2:14 and 2:20.

source.text: καὶ ἀπήνεγκέν με εἰς ἔρημον ἐν πνεύματι.

records.literal_gloss: And he carried away me into wilderness in spirit.

en.L: And he carried me away in [the] Spirit into a wilderness.
en.B: In the Spirit he took me away to a wilderness.
en.R: Then the Spirit took hold of me, and the angel carried me away to a desert.

fr.L: Et il m’emporta dans l’Esprit vers un désert.
fr.B: Dans l’Esprit, il m’emmena dans un désert.
fr.R: Alors l’Esprit s’est emparé de moi, et l’ange m’a emporté dans un désert.

sw.L: Naye akanichukua katika Roho mpaka nyikani.
sw.B: Katika Roho alinichukua mpaka nyikani.
sw.R: Kisha Roho akanishika, na yule malaika akanipeleka jangwani.

decisions.choice: carried away in the Spirit: a new vision
decisions.reason: See the note on 1:10. Ezekiel was carried by the Spirit in visions (Ezekiel 3:12-14; 8:3). John is taken to a wilderness to see the prostitute, and later to a high mountain to see the bride (21:10).

decisions.choice: the Spirit took hold of me (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:10.

decisions.choice: nyika (L, B); jangwa (R)
decisions.reason: "Nyika" is open, empty country, the word for the wilderness as settled for the Swahili New Testament; Readable says "jangwa" (desert), as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ εἶδον γυναῖκα καθημένην ἐπὶ θηρίον κόκκινον, γέμοντα ὀνόματα βλασφημίας, ἔχων κεφαλὰς ἑπτὰ καὶ κέρατα δέκα.

records.literal_gloss: And I saw a woman sitting on a beast scarlet, being full of names of blasphemy, having heads seven and horns ten.

en.L: And I saw a woman seated on a scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
en.B: I saw a woman seated on a scarlet beast. The beast was full of names that blasphemed God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
en.R: There I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that insulted God. It had seven heads and ten horns.

fr.L: Et je vis une femme assise sur une bête écarlate, pleine de noms de blasphème, ayant sept têtes et dix cornes.
fr.B: Je vis une femme assise sur une bête écarlate. La bête était couverte de noms qui blasphémaient Dieu, et elle avait sept têtes et dix cornes.
fr.R: Là, j’ai vu une femme assise sur une bête rouge. La bête était couverte de noms qui insultaient Dieu. Elle avait sept têtes et dix cornes.

sw.L: Nami nikaona mwanamke ameketi juu ya mnyama mwekundu sana, aliyejaa majina ya kufuru, mwenye vichwa saba na pembe kumi.
sw.B: Nikamwona mwanamke ameketi juu ya mnyama mwekundu sana. Mnyama huyo alikuwa amejaa majina ya kumkufuru Mungu, naye alikuwa na vichwa saba na pembe kumi.
sw.R: Huko nilimwona mwanamke ameketi juu ya mnyama mwekundu. Mnyama huyo alikuwa amejaa majina ya kumtukana Mungu. Alikuwa na vichwa saba na pembe kumi.

decisions.choice: the woman rides the beast: the city carried by the empire's power
decisions.reason: The beast is the one from the sea (13:1), with its heads, horns and blasphemous names. The woman is carried by it: the city's wealth and influence rest on the beast's power (17:7).

decisions.choice: mwekundu sana (L, B); mwekundu (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek colour is a deep red, scarlet, the dye of costly cloth (m1); Swahili has no common single word for scarlet, so Literal and Balanced say "mwekundu sana" (deep red).

source.text: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἦν περιβεβλημένη πορφυροῦν καὶ κόκκινον, καὶ κεχρυσωμένη χρυσίῳ καὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ καὶ μαργαρίταις, ἔχουσα ποτήριον χρυσοῦν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῆς γέμον βδελυγμάτων καὶ τὰ ἀκάθαρτα τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον αὐτῆς ὄνομα γεγραμμένον, μυστήριον, Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη, ἡ μήτηρ τῶν πορνῶν καὶ τῶν βδελυγμάτων τῆς γῆς.

records.literal_gloss: And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and gilded with gold and stone precious and pearls, having a cup golden in the hand of her being full of abominations and the unclean things of the immorality of her, \v 5 and on the forehead of her a name having been written, a mystery: Babylon the great, the mother of the prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.

en.L: And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stone and pearls, holding in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality, \v 5 and on her forehead a name was written, a mystery: "Babylon the great, the mother of the prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth."
en.B: The woman wore purple and scarlet, and gold, precious stones, and pearls adorned her. She held a gold cup in her hand, brimming with abominations and with the uncleanness of her immorality. \v 5 On her forehead was written a name, a mystery: "Babylon the great, mother of prostitutes and of the earth's abominations."
en.R: The woman wore purple and red clothes. She wore gold jewelry, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup. It was full of disgusting things and of her sexual sins. \v 5 A name was written on her forehead. It was a mystery, a name with a hidden meaning: "Babylon the great, the mother of prostitutes and of all the disgusting things on the earth."

fr.L: Et la femme était vêtue de pourpre et d’écarlate, et parée d’or, de pierre précieuse et de perles, tenant dans sa main une coupe d’or pleine d’abominations et des impuretés de sa prostitution, \v 5 et sur son front un nom écrit, un mystère : « Babylone la grande, la mère des prostituées et des abominations de la terre. »
fr.B: La femme était vêtue de pourpre et d’écarlate, et parée d’or, de pierres précieuses et de perles. Elle tenait à la main une coupe d’or, débordante d’abominations et des impuretés de sa débauche. \v 5 Sur son front était écrit un nom, un mystère : « Babylone la grande, mère des prostituées et des abominations de la terre. »
fr.R: La femme portait des vêtements pourpres et rouges. Elle portait des bijoux d’or, des pierres précieuses et des perles. Dans sa main, elle tenait une coupe d’or. La coupe était pleine d’horreurs et de son immoralité. \v 5 Un nom était écrit sur son front. C’était un mystère, un nom au sens caché : « Babylone la grande, la mère des prostituées et de toutes les horreurs de la terre. »

sw.L: Na yule mwanamke alikuwa amevikwa [nguo za] zambarau na nyekundu sana, amepambwa kwa dhahabu na kito cha thamani na lulu, akiwa na kikombe cha dhahabu mkononi mwake kilichojaa machukizo na uchafu wa uasherati wake, \v 5 na juu ya kipaji cha uso wake jina limeandikwa, siri: "Babeli mkuu, mama wa makahaba na wa machukizo ya dunia."
sw.B: Mwanamke huyo alivaa nguo za zambarau na nyekundu sana, na alikuwa amepambwa kwa dhahabu, vito vya thamani na lulu. Mkononi mwake alishika kikombe cha dhahabu kilichojaa machukizo na uchafu wa uasherati wake. \v 5 Kwenye kipaji cha uso wake liliandikwa jina, jina la siri: "Babeli mkuu, mama wa makahaba na wa machukizo ya dunia."
sw.R: Mwanamke huyo alivaa nguo za zambarau na nyekundu. Alivaa mapambo ya dhahabu, vito vya thamani na lulu. Mkononi mwake alishika kikombe cha dhahabu. Kilikuwa kimejaa mambo ya kuchukiza na dhambi zake za zinaa. \v 5 Jina liliandikwa kwenye kipaji cha uso wake. Lilikuwa siri, yaani jina lenye maana iliyofichika: "Babeli mkuu, mama wa makahaba na wa mambo yote ya kuchukiza duniani."

decisions.choice: purple, scarlet, gold and pearls: royal luxury
decisions.reason: Purple and scarlet dyes were costly and worn by the rich and powerful; gold, jewels and pearls are among the goods of her trade (18:12, 16). The contrast is with the bride, dressed in clean linen (19:8).

decisions.choice: abominations: idolatry and what God detests
decisions.reason: βδελυγμάτων is the word the Old Testament uses for idols and idolatrous practices (Deuteronomy 29:17; Daniel 9:27; Matthew 24:15). Her golden cup looks precious but holds what is vile (compare Jeremiah 51:7).

decisions.choice: a name on her forehead, a mystery
alternatives: "Mystery" is part of the name itself
decisions.reason: The name is written on her forehead, as God's name is on the foreheads of his people (14:1) and the beast's mark on its followers (13:16). μυστήριον most likely says that the name is to be understood in a hidden sense, as the angel explains (17:7): Babylon is not the city on the Euphrates but what it stands for.

decisions.choice: mystery; a name with a hidden meaning (R)
decisions.reason: Mystery is a key term; Readable adds what it means.

decisions.choice: une coupe d’or
decisions.reason: French uses "coupe" both for the angels' bowls and for a drinking cup, where the Greek has two words. "Calice" would suggest the cup of the Mass, and "gobelet" is too ordinary for a royal vessel. The context keeps the two apart: the bowls belong to the angels, the cup is in the woman's hand.

decisions.choice: des horreurs (R)
decisions.reason: Readable needs a plain word for "abominations" (m2); "horreurs" is everyday French for what is detestable and keeps the moral sense better than "choses dégoûtantes", which sounds physical.

decisions.choice: machukizo (L, B); mambo ya kuchukiza (R)
decisions.reason: "Machukizo" are things God detests, the Old Testament word for idolatry and its practices (m2); Readable spells it out as "mambo ya kuchukiza" (disgusting things), as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ εἶδον τὴν γυναῖκα μεθύουσαν ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν μαρτύρων Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And I saw the woman being drunk from the blood of the saints and from the blood of the witnesses of Jesus.

en.L: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the witnesses of Jesus.
en.B: And I saw the woman drunk on the blood of God's holy people and on the blood of Jesus's witnesses.
en.R: I saw that the woman was drunk from drinking the blood of God's people, the blood of those who told the truth about Jesus.

fr.L: Et je vis la femme ivre du sang des saints et du sang des témoins de Jésus.
fr.B: Et je vis la femme ivre du sang du peuple saint de Dieu et du sang des témoins de Jésus.
fr.R: J’ai vu que la femme était ivre : elle avait bu le sang du peuple de Dieu, le sang de ceux qui avaient dit la vérité sur Jésus.

sw.L: Nami nikamwona yule mwanamke amelewa damu ya watakatifu na damu ya mashahidi wa Yesu.
sw.B: Nikamwona mwanamke huyo amelewa damu ya watu watakatifu wa Mungu na damu ya mashahidi wa Yesu.
sw.R: Nikaona kwamba mwanamke huyo amelewa kwa kunywa damu ya watu wa Mungu, damu ya wale waliosema ukweli kuhusu Yesu.

decisions.choice: drunk with blood: the persecution of God's people
decisions.reason: The city has killed God's people and those who bore witness to Jesus (18:24). The Roman historian Tacitus tells how Nero had Christians put to death in Rome after the fire of AD 64. μαρτύρων means witnesses; the word was coming to mean martyrs.

decisions.choice: saints (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:8.

decisions.choice: les saints (L); le peuple saint de Dieu (B); le peuple de Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide's term for the whole New Testament and the English here: "les saints" today suggests canonised individuals, so Balanced and Readable name God's people. The same holds in chapters 18 to 20.

source.text: Καὶ ἐθαύμασα ἰδὼν αὐτὴν θαῦμα μέγα·

records.literal_gloss: And I marveled having seen her with marvel great.

en.L: And when I saw her, I marveled with great wonder.
en.B: The sight of her filled me with great amazement.
en.R: When I saw her, I was very amazed.

fr.L: Et, en la voyant, je m’étonnai d’un grand étonnement.
fr.B: En la voyant, je fus saisi d’un grand étonnement.
fr.R: Quand je l’ai vue, j’ai été très étonné.

sw.L: Nami nikastaajabu nilipomwona, mshangao mkubwa.
sw.B: Nilipomwona nilistaajabu mno.
sw.R: Nilipomwona, nilishangaa sana.

decisions.choice: great wonder: astonishment, not admiration
decisions.reason: John is astounded at what he sees. The same verb is used of the world's wondering at the beast (13:3; 17:8), and the angel's question (17:7) checks any hint of fascination.

source.text: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ ἄγγελος· Διὰ τί ἐθαύμασας;

records.literal_gloss: And said to me the angel: Why did you marvel?

en.L: And the angel said to me, "Why did you marvel?
en.B: But the angel said to me, "Why are you amazed?
en.R: The angel asked me, "Why are you so amazed?

fr.L: Et l’ange me dit : « Pourquoi t’es-tu étonné ?
fr.B: Mais l’ange me dit : « Pourquoi es-tu étonné ?
fr.R: L’ange m’a demandé : « Pourquoi es-tu si étonné ?

sw.L: Naye malaika akaniambia, "Kwa nini ulistaajabu?
sw.B: Lakini malaika akaniambia, "Kwa nini unastaajabu?
sw.R: Malaika akaniuliza, "Kwa nini unashangaa hivyo?

decisions.choice: the angel's explanation begins
decisions.reason: The angel's words run from here to the end of 17:14 and resume at 17:15.

source.text: ἐγὼ ἐρῶ σοι τὸ μυστήριον τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ τοῦ θηρίου τοῦ βαστάζοντος αὐτήν, τοῦ ἔχοντος τὰς ἑπτὰ κεφαλὰς καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα·

records.literal_gloss: I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast the carrying her, the having the seven heads and the ten horns.

en.L: I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
en.B: Let me tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast with the seven heads and ten horns that carries her.
en.R: I will tell you the mystery, the secret meaning, of the woman and of the beast she is riding. It is the beast with seven heads and ten horns.

fr.L: Moi, je te dirai le mystère de la femme et de la bête qui la porte, celle qui a les sept têtes et les dix cornes.
fr.B: Je vais te dire le mystère de la femme, et de la bête aux sept têtes et aux dix cornes qui la porte.
fr.R: Je vais t’expliquer le mystère, le sens caché, de la femme et de la bête qu’elle chevauche. C’est la bête qui a sept têtes et dix cornes.

sw.L: Mimi nitakuambia siri ya mwanamke huyo na ya mnyama anayembeba, aliye na vichwa saba na pembe kumi.
sw.B: Nitakueleza siri ya mwanamke huyo, na ya mnyama mwenye vichwa saba na pembe kumi anayembeba.
sw.R: Nitakuambia siri, yaani maana iliyofichika, ya mwanamke huyo na ya mnyama anayempanda. Ni mnyama mwenye vichwa saba na pembe kumi.

decisions.choice: the mystery: the meaning of the vision, now explained
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, the angel explains what the symbols stand for. The explanation still uses pictures and needs wisdom (17:9).

decisions.choice: mystery; the secret meaning (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20.

source.text: τὸ θηρίον ὃ εἶδες ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν, καὶ μέλλει ἀναβαίνειν ἐκ τῆς ἀβύσσου, καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει· καὶ θαυμασθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ὧν οὐ γέγραπται τὸ ὄνομα ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον τῆς ζωῆς ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, βλεπόντων τὸ θηρίον ὅτι ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ παρέσται.

records.literal_gloss: The beast which you saw was and is not, and is about to come up out of the abyss and into destruction goes; and will marvel those dwelling on the earth, of whom not has been written the name on the book of the life from foundation of world, seeing the beast that it was and is not and will be present.

en.L: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to come up out of the abyss and goes to destruction; and those who live on the earth, whose name has not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will marvel when they see the beast, that it was and is not and will be present.
en.B: The beast that you saw existed once and exists no longer; it is going to rise out of the abyss, and it goes on to destruction. The people of the earth, those whose names have not been written in the book of life since the world was founded, will marvel to see the beast, for it was, and is not, and will be present again.
en.R: The beast you saw was alive once, but it is not alive now. It will come up out of the bottomless pit, but then it will be destroyed. The people on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the world was made will be amazed when they see the beast. It was once alive, it is not alive now, but it will come again.

fr.L: La bête que tu as vue était, et n’est pas, et va monter de l’abîme, et elle s’en va à la perdition ; et les habitants de la terre, dont le nom n’a pas été écrit dans le livre de la vie depuis la fondation du monde, s’étonneront en voyant la bête, parce qu’elle était, et n’est pas, et sera présente.
fr.B: La bête que tu as vue a existé et n’existe plus ; elle va remonter de l’abîme, puis elle s’en va à sa destruction. Les habitants de la terre, ceux dont le nom n’a pas été écrit dans le livre de vie depuis la fondation du monde, s’étonneront en voyant la bête, car elle était, elle n’est plus, et elle reviendra.
fr.R: La bête que tu as vue était vivante autrefois, mais elle n’est pas vivante maintenant. Elle va remonter du gouffre sans fond, mais ensuite elle sera détruite. Les habitants de la terre dont le nom n’a pas été écrit dans le livre de vie avant la création du monde seront très étonnés quand ils verront la bête. Elle était vivante autrefois, elle n’est pas vivante maintenant, mais elle reviendra.

sw.L: Mnyama uliyemwona alikuwako, naye hayupo, naye yu karibu kupanda kutoka kilindini, naye anakwenda kwenye uharibifu; nao wakaao juu ya dunia, ambao jina lao halijaandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima tangu kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu, watastaajabu wamwonapo mnyama, kwamba alikuwako na hayupo na atakuwapo.
sw.B: Mnyama uliyemwona alikuwako zamani, na sasa hayupo; atapanda kutoka kilindini, naye anaelekea kwenye maangamizi. Wakazi wa dunia, wale ambao majina yao hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima tangu ulimwengu ulipoumbwa, watastaajabu watakapomwona mnyama huyo, kwa sababu alikuwako, na hayupo, naye atakuwapo tena.
sw.R: Mnyama uliyemwona alikuwa hai zamani, lakini sasa hayuko hai. Atapanda kutoka katika shimo lisilo na mwisho, lakini kisha ataangamizwa. Kuna watu duniani ambao majina yao hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima kabla ulimwengu haujaumbwa. Watu hao watashangaa watakapomwona mnyama huyo. Alikuwa hai zamani, sasa hayuko hai, lakini atakuja tena.

decisions.choice: was, is not, and will come: a parody of God's name
decisions.reason: God is the one "who is and who was and who is coming" (1:4, 8). The beast "was, and is not, and will come up": it mimics God's eternity and Christ's death and resurrection (13:3, 14), but its coming leads only to destruction.

decisions.choice: the beast that returns: perhaps the legend of Nero
decisions.reason: See the note on 13:3. The language of a ruler who was, is not, and will return may echo the rumors that Nero would come back.

decisions.choice: names not written from the foundation of the world
decisions.reason: See the note on 13:8.

decisions.choice: abyss (L, B); bottomless pit (R)
decisions.reason: As in 9:1.

decisions.choice: l’abîme (L, B); le gouffre sans fond (R); la perdition (L), la destruction (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal and Balanced keep the name of the place, Readable says what it is. For the beast's end, Literal keeps the older "perdition", which in French also means ruin; Balanced and Readable say "destruction", which cannot be read as only moral loss.

decisions.choice: kilindi (L, B); shimo lisilo na mwisho (R)
decisions.reason: "Kilindi" (the deep) for the abyss, as settled for the Swahili New Testament (Luke 8:31); Readable says "shimo lisilo na mwisho" (a pit without end), as the English Readable says "bottomless pit". "Kuzimu" is kept for Hades.

decisions.choice: kitabu cha uzima
decisions.reason: "Kitabu cha uzima", as in 3:5: "uzima" is life itself, the life God gives.

source.text: Ὧδε ὁ νοῦς ὁ ἔχων σοφίαν.

records.literal_gloss: Here the mind the having wisdom.

en.L: Here [is] the mind that has wisdom.
en.B: Here a wise mind is needed.
en.R: Here you need wisdom to understand.

fr.L: Ici [est] l’intelligence qui a de la sagesse.
fr.B: C’est ici qu’il faut un esprit sage.
fr.R: Ici, il faut de la sagesse pour comprendre.

sw.L: Hapa ndipo [inahitajika] akili iliyo na hekima.
sw.B: Hapa akili yenye hekima inahitajika.
sw.R: Hapa unahitaji hekima ili kuelewa.

decisions.choice: a call for wisdom, as in 13:18
decisions.reason: The angel calls for understanding, as John did with the number of the beast. The symbols point to realities the readers can recognize.

source.text: αἱ ἑπτὰ κεφαλαὶ ἑπτὰ ὄρη εἰσίν, ὅπου ἡ γυνὴ κάθηται ἐπ’ αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: The seven heads seven mountains are, where the woman sits on them.

en.L: The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.
en.B: The seven heads are seven mountains, and the woman is seated on them.
en.R: The seven heads are seven hills where the woman sits.

fr.L: Les sept têtes sont sept montagnes, sur lesquelles la femme est assise.
fr.B: Les sept têtes sont sept montagnes, et c’est sur elles que la femme est assise.
fr.R: Les sept têtes sont les sept collines où la femme est assise.

sw.L: Vile vichwa saba ni milima saba, ambayo mwanamke huyo ameketi juu yake.
sw.B: Vichwa hivyo saba ni milima saba, na mwanamke huyo ameketi juu yake.
sw.R: Vichwa saba ni vilima saba ambavyo mwanamke huyo ameketi juu yake.

decisions.choice: seven mountains: the seven hills of Rome
alternatives: seven kingdoms, since mountains can stand for kingdoms (Jeremiah 51:25; Daniel 2:35)
decisions.reason: Rome was famous as the city on seven hills, and its writers and coins spoke of it so. To John's readers the woman seated on seven hills would most naturally be Rome. The next sentence gives the heads a second meaning, seven kings, so the symbol is not exhausted by geography.

decisions.choice: mountains (L, B); hills (R)
decisions.reason: ὄρη means mountain or hill; Readable uses "hills", the familiar description of Rome.

source.text: καὶ βασιλεῖς ἑπτά εἰσιν·

records.literal_gloss: And kings seven are.

en.L: And they are seven kings.
en.B: They are also seven kings.
en.R: They are also seven kings.

fr.L: Et ce sont sept rois.
fr.B: Ce sont aussi sept rois.
fr.R: Les sept têtes représentent aussi sept rois.

sw.L: Na ni wafalme saba.
sw.B: Pia ni wafalme saba.
sw.R: Pia ni wafalme saba.

decisions.choice: a second meaning for the seven heads
decisions.reason: The heads are both seven mountains and seven kings: the symbol has more than one meaning.

source.text: οἱ πέντε ἔπεσαν, ὁ εἷς ἔστιν, ὁ ἄλλος οὔπω ἦλθεν, καὶ ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὀλίγον αὐτὸν δεῖ μεῖναι, καὶ τὸ θηρίον ὃ ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν.

records.literal_gloss: The five fell, the one is, the other not yet came, and when he comes a little him it is necessary to remain. \v 11 And the beast which was and is not,

en.L: The five have fallen, the one is, the other has not yet come, and when he comes he must remain a little while. \v 11 And the beast that was and is not,
en.B: Five of them have fallen; one is now; the other is still to come, and when he does, he must remain only briefly. \v 11 And the beast that was and is not
en.R: Five of these kings have already died. One is ruling now. The last one has not come yet. When he comes, he will rule for only a short time. \v 11 The beast that was alive once and is not alive now

fr.L: Les cinq sont tombés, l’un est, l’autre n’est pas encore venu, et quand il viendra, il doit demeurer peu de temps. \v 11 Et la bête qui était et n’est pas,
fr.B: Cinq d’entre eux sont tombés ; l’un est là maintenant ; l’autre n’est pas encore venu, et quand il viendra, il ne devra rester que peu de temps. \v 11 Quant à la bête qui était et n’est plus,
fr.R: Cinq de ces rois sont déjà morts. L’un règne maintenant. Le dernier n’est pas encore venu. Quand il viendra, il ne régnera que peu de temps. \v 11 La bête qui était vivante autrefois et qui ne l’est plus maintenant

sw.L: Watano wameanguka, mmoja yupo, mwingine bado hajaja, na atakapokuja, imempasa kukaa kwa muda mfupi. \v 11 Na yule mnyama aliyekuwako, naye hayupo,
sw.B: Watano kati yao wameanguka; mmoja yupo sasa; mwingine bado hajaja, na atakapokuja itampasa kukaa kwa muda mfupi tu. \v 11 Na yule mnyama aliyekuwako na sasa hayupo
sw.R: Wafalme watano kati yao wameshakufa. Mmoja anatawala sasa. Wa mwisho bado hajaja. Atakapokuja, atatawala kwa muda mfupi tu. \v 11 Yule mnyama aliyekuwa hai zamani na sasa hayuko hai

decisions.choice: seven kings: a series of rulers, most of them past
alternatives: seven Roman emperors, counted from Augustus or from Julius Caesar
seven empires (Egypt, Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and one to come)
a symbolic seven: the whole line of earthly rulers
decisions.reason: Many have tried to count seven emperors so that the sixth is reigning when John writes, but the count depends on where one starts and whom one includes, and no count fits every detail. Seven may also stand for completeness: the series of earthly powers is almost finished, and the last will be brief.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into 17:11
decisions.reason: The source data divides the sentence so that "and the beast that was and is not" closes this record and its predicate, "is itself an eighth", opens the next. The record follows that division.

decisions.choice: the subject left open at the end (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: Every level ends with the subject of 17:11, completed in the next record, as the record division requires (m2).

source.text: καὶ αὐτὸς ὄγδοός ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑπτά ἐστιν, καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει.

records.literal_gloss: also he an eighth is, and out of the seven is, and into destruction goes.

en.L: it is itself also an eighth, and it is of the seven, and it goes to destruction.
en.B: is an eighth king, and yet it belongs to the seven, and it is on its way to destruction.
en.R: is an eighth king. But it belongs with the seven kings, and it is going to be destroyed.

fr.L: elle-même aussi est un huitième, et elle est des sept, et elle s’en va à la perdition.
fr.B: elle est un huitième roi, et pourtant elle fait partie des sept, et elle s’en va à sa destruction.
fr.R: est un huitième roi. Mais elle fait partie des sept rois, et elle va être détruite.

sw.L: yeye mwenyewe pia ni wa nane, naye ni mmoja wa wale saba, naye anakwenda kwenye uharibifu.
sw.B: ni mfalme wa nane, lakini yeye ni mmoja wa wale saba, naye anaelekea kwenye maangamizi.
sw.R: ni mfalme wa nane. Lakini yeye ni mmoja wa wale wafalme saba, naye ataangamizwa.

decisions.choice: an eighth that belongs to the seven
decisions.reason: The beast is a further ruler, an eighth, yet of the same kind as the seven, perhaps one of them returned (17:8). Eight was also the number of new beginnings, and the beast's return parodies resurrection. Whatever it is, its end is destruction.

source.text: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες δέκα βασιλεῖς εἰσιν, οἵτινες βασιλείαν οὔπω ἔλαβον, ἀλλὰ ἐξουσίαν ὡς βασιλεῖς μίαν ὥραν λαμβάνουσιν μετὰ τοῦ θηρίου.

records.literal_gloss: And the ten horns which you saw ten kings are, who a kingdom not yet received, but authority as kings one hour receive with the beast.

en.L: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom, but they receive authority as kings for one hour with the beast.
en.B: As for the ten horns you saw, they are ten kings who have no kingdom yet; but together with the beast they receive royal authority for one hour.
en.R: The ten horns you saw are ten kings. They have not started to rule yet. But they will rule with the beast for a very short time.

fr.L: Et les dix cornes que tu as vues sont dix rois, qui n’ont pas encore reçu de royaume, mais ils reçoivent autorité comme rois pour une heure avec la bête.
fr.B: Quant aux dix cornes que tu as vues, ce sont dix rois qui n’ont pas encore de royaume ; mais ils reçoivent, avec la bête, une autorité royale pour une heure.
fr.R: Les dix cornes que tu as vues sont dix rois. Ils n’ont pas encore commencé à régner. Mais ils régneront avec la bête pendant très peu de temps.

sw.L: Na zile pembe kumi ulizoziona ni wafalme kumi, ambao bado hawajapokea ufalme, lakini wanapokea mamlaka kama wafalme kwa saa moja pamoja na mnyama.
sw.B: Zile pembe kumi ulizoziona ni wafalme kumi ambao bado hawajapata ufalme; lakini pamoja na mnyama watapokea mamlaka ya kifalme kwa saa moja.
sw.R: Zile pembe kumi ulizoziona ni wafalme kumi. Bado hawajaanza kutawala. Lakini watatawala pamoja na mnyama kwa muda mfupi sana.

decisions.choice: ten horns, ten kings: Daniel 7:24
decisions.reason: "As for the ten horns, out of this kingdom ten kings shall arise" (Daniel 7:24). "One hour" means a very short time.

source.text: οὗτοι μίαν γνώμην ἔχουσιν, καὶ τὴν δύναμιν καὶ ἐξουσίαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ διδόασιν.

records.literal_gloss: These one mind have, and the power and authority of them to the beast they give.

en.L: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
en.B: They are of one mind, and they hand over their power and authority to the beast.
en.R: These kings all agree with each other. They will give their power and authority to the beast.

fr.L: Ceux-ci ont un seul dessein, et ils donnent leur puissance et leur autorité à la bête.
fr.B: Ils n’ont qu’une seule pensée, et ils remettent leur puissance et leur autorité à la bête.
fr.R: Ces rois sont tous d’accord entre eux. Ils donneront leur puissance et leur autorité à la bête.

sw.L: Hawa wana nia moja, nao wanampa mnyama nguvu zao na mamlaka yao.
sw.B: Hao wana nia moja, nao wanamkabidhi mnyama nguvu zao na mamlaka yao.
sw.R: Wafalme hao wote wanakubaliana. Watampa mnyama nguvu zao na mamlaka yao.

decisions.choice: one mind: a single purpose
decisions.reason: γνώμην means purpose or intention. They act together in serving the beast, and God uses that very purpose (17:17).

decisions.choice: un seul dessein (L), here and in 17:17
decisions.reason: The same Greek word means God's purpose and the kings' common purpose in 17:17; Literal uses "dessein" in both places so that the link shows. Balanced and Readable say it naturally ("une seule pensée", "d’un commun accord", "tous d’accord").

source.text: οὗτοι μετὰ τοῦ ἀρνίου πολεμήσουσιν, καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον νικήσει αὐτούς, ὅτι κύριος κυρίων ἐστὶν καὶ βασιλεὺς βασιλέων, καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ κλητοὶ καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ καὶ πιστοί.

records.literal_gloss: These with the Lamb will make war, and the Lamb will overcome them, because Lord of lords he is and King of kings, and those with him called and chosen and faithful.

en.L: These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is Lord of lords and King of kings, and those with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [are] called and chosen and faithful."
en.B: They will make war on the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} are the called, the chosen, the faithful."
en.R: They will fight against the Lamb. But the Lamb will win the victory over them, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the Lord over all lords and the King over all kings. The people with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} are the ones God has called and chosen, and they are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

fr.L: Ceux-ci feront la guerre à l’Agneau, et l’Agneau les vaincra, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est Seigneur des seigneurs et Roi des rois, et ceux qui [sont] avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [sont] appelés, élus et fidèles. »
fr.B: Ils feront la guerre à l’Agneau, et l’Agneau les vaincra, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est Seigneur des seigneurs et Roi des rois ; et ceux qui sont avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont les appelés, les élus, les fidèles. »
fr.R: Ils combattront contre l’Agneau. Mais l’Agneau remportera la victoire sur eux, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est le Seigneur au-dessus de tous les seigneurs et le Roi au-dessus de tous les rois. Ceux qui sont avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, ce sont ceux que Dieu a appelés et choisis, et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont fidèles. »

sw.L: Hawa watafanya vita na Mwanakondoo, na Mwanakondoo atawashinda, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni Bwana wa mabwana na Mfalme wa wafalme, na walio pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} [ni] walioitwa na wateule na waaminifu."
sw.B: Watapigana vita na Mwanakondoo, lakini Mwanakondoo atawashinda, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni Bwana wa mabwana na Mfalme wa wafalme; na wale walio pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ni walioitwa, waliochaguliwa na waaminifu."
sw.R: Watapigana na Mwanakondoo. Lakini Mwanakondoo atapata ushindi juu yao, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni Bwana juu ya mabwana wote na Mfalme juu ya wafalme wote. Watu walio pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ni wale ambao Mungu amewaita na kuwachagua, nao ni waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}."

decisions.choice: Lord of lords and King of kings
decisions.reason: God is "God of gods and Lord of lords" (Deuteronomy 10:17; compare Daniel 2:47). The Lamb bears the title, and it is written on him in 19:16.

decisions.choice: the called, chosen and faithful share the Lamb's victory
decisions.reason: Those with the Lamb are called and chosen by God and have stayed faithful (compare Matthew 22:14). The battle is described in 19:11-21.

decisions.choice: overcome (L, B); win the victory (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:5.

decisions.choice: atawashinda (L, B); atapata ushindi juu yao (R); wateule (L), waliochaguliwa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for the one who overcomes in the seven letters, so it is "kushinda" at Literal and Balanced and "kupata ushindi" at Readable, as there. The elect are "wateule" at Literal and "waliochaguliwa" at Balanced and Readable, as settled for the Swahili New Testament.

source.text: Καὶ λέγει μοι· Τὰ ὕδατα ἃ εἶδες, οὗ ἡ πόρνη κάθηται, λαοὶ καὶ ὄχλοι εἰσὶν καὶ ἔθνη καὶ γλῶσσαι.

records.literal_gloss: And he says to me: The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, peoples and crowds are and nations and tongues.

en.L: And he says to me, "The waters that you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples and crowds and nations and languages.
en.B: He went on: "The waters you saw, on which the prostitute sits, are peoples and crowds, nations and languages.
en.R: Then the angel said to me, "You saw the waters where the prostitute sits. They are the peoples, crowds, nations, and languages of the world.

fr.L: Et il me dit : « Les eaux que tu as vues, là où la prostituée est assise, sont des peuples et des foules, et des nations et des langues.
fr.B: Il poursuivit : « Les eaux que tu as vues, sur lesquelles la prostituée est assise, ce sont des peuples et des foules, des nations et des langues.
fr.R: Puis l’ange m’a dit : « Tu as vu les eaux où la prostituée est assise. Ce sont les peuples, les foules, les nations et les langues du monde.

sw.L: Naye ananiambia, "Yale maji uliyoyaona, ambapo yule kahaba ameketi, ni watu na umati na mataifa na lugha.
sw.B: Akaendelea kusema: "Yale maji uliyoyaona, ambayo juu yake kahaba ameketi, ni watu na umati, mataifa na lugha.
sw.R: Kisha malaika akaniambia, "Uliona maji pale ambapo kahaba ameketi. Maji hayo ni watu, makundi ya watu, mataifa na lugha za dunia.

decisions.choice: waters as peoples
decisions.reason: The prophets compare peoples and armies to floods of water (Isaiah 8:7; 17:12-13; Jeremiah 47:2). The city sits enthroned over many nations.

source.text: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες καὶ τὸ θηρίον, οὗτοι μισήσουσι τὴν πόρνην, καὶ ἠρημωμένην ποιήσουσιν αὐτὴν καὶ γυμνήν, καὶ τὰς σάρκας αὐτῆς φάγονται, καὶ αὐτὴν κατακαύσουσιν ἐν πυρί·

records.literal_gloss: And the ten horns which you saw and the beast, these will hate the prostitute and desolate will make her and naked, and the flesh of her they will eat and her they will burn up with fire.

en.L: And the ten horns that you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute and will make her desolate and naked, and they will eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.
en.B: The ten horns and the beast that you saw will turn against the prostitute in hatred, leave her ruined and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her up with fire.
en.R: The ten horns and the beast you saw will hate the prostitute. They will take everything she has and leave her naked. They will eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.

fr.L: Et les dix cornes que tu as vues, et la bête, ceux-ci haïront la prostituée, et ils la rendront dévastée et nue, et ils mangeront ses chairs et la brûleront au feu.
fr.B: Les dix cornes et la bête que tu as vues se retourneront contre la prostituée avec haine ; elles la laisseront ruinée et nue, mangeront sa chair et la brûleront au feu.
fr.R: Les dix cornes et la bête que tu as vues détesteront la prostituée. Elles lui prendront tout ce qu’elle a et la laisseront nue. Elles mangeront sa chair et la brûleront complètement.

sw.L: Na zile pembe kumi ulizoziona, na yule mnyama, hawa watamchukia yule kahaba, nao watamfanya kuwa ukiwa na uchi, nao watakula nyama yake, nao watamteketeza kwa moto.
sw.B: Zile pembe kumi ulizoziona na yule mnyama watamgeukia yule kahaba kwa chuki; watamwacha ameharibiwa na yu uchi, watakula nyama yake na kumteketeza kwa moto.
sw.R: Zile pembe kumi na yule mnyama uliowaona watamchukia yule kahaba. Watamnyang'anya kila kitu alicho nacho na kumwacha uchi. Watakula nyama yake na kumteketeza kwa moto.

decisions.choice: her lovers turn on her: Ezekiel 16 and 23
decisions.reason: In Ezekiel the nations with whom unfaithful Jerusalem played the harlot strip her and destroy her (Ezekiel 16:37-41; 23:25-29). Evil turns on itself: the powers that carried the city destroy it.

decisions.choice: a picture of a city's ruin
decisions.reason: The violent images are the prophets' way of describing the fall of a city (compare 18:8-9, where Babylon is burned). They describe God's judgment on a corrupt power and give no license for violence against anyone.

decisions.choice: ceux-ci … ils (L); elles (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek pronoun is masculine: it thinks of the kings that the horns stand for, not of the feminine words "cornes" and "bête". Literal keeps that shift; Balanced and Readable make the verbs agree with their French subject.

source.text: ὁ γὰρ θεὸς ἔδωκεν εἰς τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν ποιῆσαι τὴν γνώμην αὐτοῦ, καὶ ποιῆσαι μίαν γνώμην καὶ δοῦναι τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ, ἄχρι τελεσθήσονται οἱ λόγοι τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: For the God gave into the hearts of them to do the purpose of him, and to do one purpose and to give the kingdom of them to the beast, until will be completed the words of the God.

en.L: For God has put into their hearts to carry out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} purpose, and to carry out one purpose, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
en.B: It is God who has moved their hearts to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} intends: to act with one mind and to hand their kingdom over to the beast, until God's words have been fulfilled.
en.R: God made them want to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planned. So they agreed to give their power to rule to the beast. This will last until everything God has said comes true.

fr.L: Car Dieu a mis dans leurs cœurs d’exécuter {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} dessein, et d’exécuter un seul dessein, et de donner leur royaume à la bête, jusqu’à ce que les paroles de Dieu soient accomplies.
fr.B: C’est Dieu qui a disposé leurs cœurs à faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a résolu : agir d’un commun accord et remettre leur royaume à la bête, jusqu’à ce que les paroles de Dieu soient accomplies.
fr.R: Dieu leur a donné l’envie de faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prévu. Alors ils se sont mis d’accord pour donner leur pouvoir de régner à la bête. Cela durera jusqu’à ce que tout ce que Dieu a dit se réalise.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu ametia katika mioyo yao kutekeleza kusudi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, na kutekeleza kusudi moja, na kumpa mnyama ufalme wao, mpaka maneno ya Mungu yatimizwe.
sw.B: Ni Mungu aliyetia mioyoni mwao kufanya kile {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anachokusudia: wawe na nia moja na kumkabidhi mnyama ufalme wao, mpaka maneno ya Mungu yatimie.
sw.R: Mungu aliwafanya watake kufanya kile {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alichopanga. Kwa hiyo walikubaliana kumpa mnyama mamlaka yao ya kutawala. Hali hiyo itaendelea mpaka kila kitu Mungu alichosema kitimie.

decisions.choice: God uses even the plans of his enemies
decisions.reason: The kings act by their own will, but God has put it in their hearts, so that what they do serves his purpose, as he used Assyria as the rod of his anger (Isaiah 10:5-7). Their alliance with the beast lasts only until God's words are fulfilled.

source.text: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἣν εἶδες ἔστιν ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη ἡ ἔχουσα βασιλείαν ἐπὶ τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς.

decisions.choice: the great city that rules the kings: Rome in John's day, and every such power
decisions.reason: In John's day only Rome ruled over the kings of the earth, and with the seven hills (17:9) the identification would have been plain to his readers. But the city is given a symbolic name, Babylon, and its fall is told in words from the prophets' oracles against Babylon and Tyre: it stands for every power that sets itself against God and his people.
